name: ANSI/IEEE four-position maintained selector symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for four-position maintained selector, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The four-position maintained selector form supports four stable selections tied to a documented contact table. Position order matters when interpreting mode combinations, but physical rotation alone does not identify connected circuits.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Compare the drawing position order to the operator faceplate.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Four stable positions do not necessarily mean four contact poles.
